about: The term sheet kit/check.mjs reads. It is checked against the RENDERED page. A retired string fails anywhere on it, design prose included (prose that describes a retired control as current misleads the owner too); a required string counts only inside product frames in the participant view (?study), so a design note cannot satisfy it. A frame marked data-frame="before" is skipped. 'retired' fails any page that shows the text; 'required' fails the named state when the text is missing, or when the state does not exist yet (a state to draw). Each entry gives its reason. The frame rules (the rail, one right panel, no avatar, no top-right Export) and the two-homes rules are code in check.mjs, named in 'rules' so the sheet lists every gate in one place.
exemptWhy: The study's own records of past rounds (study/index.html) and of what each round tested (study/coverage.html), which quote retired terms as history.

retired.why: Export... is in the project-name menu and the File list; there is no top-right Export files button (owner review item 1).

retired.label: Style files / style file
retired.why: Recipe is the one noun for a saved style or workflow file.
Deleted: each filter step's own delete on the filter chip covers it.
Deleted: Ctrl+Z restores a cleared selection.

retired.label: the Previous selection key (Ctrl+Alt+Z)
retired.why: Deleted with the Previous selection command: Ctrl+Z restores a cleared selection.
Deleted: the meaning of a weight is chosen for each run, with nothing preselected.
The walk's readout names its column: amount 0.98.
retired.label: 'weight 0.98' (the walk's readout names its column)
the Print look's 'within ... of 0 drawn as no change' sentence
retired.why: No band that nobody set: the Print look's no-change band is removed.

retired.label: 'result' used to mean a value
retired.why: Results is the place, a run is the object, a value is a number on a node.

retired.label: Shift+Enter for a new line in a note
retired.why: In a note, Enter starts a new line and Ctrl+Enter adds it.

retired.label: 'Selection cleared on canvas' / 'Selection restored: N'
retired.why: One message shape: 'Selection cleared (N nodes). Ctrl+Z brings it back.' and 'Selection restored (N nodes).'
Edit > Undo names every entry the same way: 'Undo Restore selection (N nodes)'.
No invented tie rule: the percentage is not a property of the data. An exact measure shows '=' only when values are equal at the shown precision; an estimate shows its rank range.

retired.label: 'near #N' in a rank cell
retired.why: Rank is an integer; a tie is '=' at the shown precision (exact) or a rank range (estimate). 'near #8' made the rank column text in Excel and pandas.
A column's meaning as a weight is asked by each run that uses it, never set on the data: 'amount: $ (USD). Each run that uses it asks what a higher amount means.'

retired.label: 'Change...' on a data source
retired.why: A data source states facts only; its one action is 'Update with new data...'. The Loaded line's 'Change...' drew 27 wrong first clicks. (The note editor's 'Saving as: <name>. Change...' is the author setting, not a data source, and stays.)

retired.label: 'linked pairs'
retired.why: One noun for a pair of nodes counted once however many rows join them: 'distinct pairs' ('Evidence rows 2,298 (1,262 distinct pairs)').

retired.label: 'Usage statistics'
retired.why: One name for what is sent only after the person says yes: 'Usage data' (Where your data goes, Sent and saved, Preferences > Usage data).

retired.label: 'a bigger <column> means'
retired.why: The weight question reads 'For amount, a higher number means...', and the data line echoes it: 'Each run that uses it asks what a higher amount means.' One adjective, higher.

retired.label: 'Compare with another column...'
retired.why: The column menu's scatter view is 'Compare columns...'; 'Compare with another run...' belongs to a run, 'Compare with another version...' to a data version, 'Compare with the rest' to a group or set.

required.why: In a note, Enter starts a new line and Ctrl+Enter posts, with a hint under the box.
A refused run reads 'Not run: would take about <estimate>', with no failure mark.
A refused run reads 'Not run: would take about <estimate>', with no failure mark.
On the transfers, weighted degree is Money in / Money out, and a link count is Links in (count), so a ranking by link count never looks like money.
Weighted degree in the catalog and Quick actions under the money words; link-count measures labelled as counts. A state to draw: the transfers' catalog.
After Ctrl+Z restores a cleared selection, the undo line reads 'Selection restored (18 nodes)'. A state to draw.

required.label: a subset scope such as 'on 60 of 77'
required.why: Every value computed on a subset carries its scope ('0.419, on 60 of 77').

rules.frame: Every product k-app: the rail reads main menu, Graph, Data, Results, Notes, Assistant; one right column; no avatar; no Export button in a header row; no Styles section in the Graph panel. kit/shell.mjs draws it.
rules.counts: A count or statistic that kit/fixtures.json does not hold, a bound number that differs from its fixture, or two pages that show one fixture value differently.
twoHomes: a Results section in the inspector with nothing selected (runs live on the Results rail place)
a Previous selection command (Ctrl+Z restores a cleared selection)
an Apply dialog without 'Use these styles' (a second Apply dialog)
